inference: No new calls; accepted nine-model90-frame/130-ROI controlled cohort unchanged
non_Face_reuse: Hair61/Upper112/Lower96 tasks and numeric statistics unchanged from accepted diagnostic index
Face_reference: Source Face contour minus manually reviewed known Neck and GT-only uncertain/occluder pixels. This is not independent anatomical gold or strict face-only deployment output.
Face_domain: Original grid minus own known Neck and explicit GT-only uncertainty. Known opaque occluder cores are valid negative pixels, not amodal Neck or ignore.
uncertain_Neck: Manually bounded possible own-Neck region is unknown, not absent. Face-domain may score remaining source Face; Face+Neck delivery and NeckCoverage are unavailable for that item.
FaceNeck_delivery: Face union known Neck on grid minus GT-only uncertainty; only VISIBLE_ANNOTATED/VERIFIED_NOT_VISIBLE cases eligible
Neck_coverage: Candidate recall on known visible Neck; null for unknown/no-support items; not Neck-only IoU
matching: Reuse exact GT-source-union to frozen-YOLO assignments from parent binding; new Neck/uncertainty do not alter matching or predictions
primary: Arithmetic mean of mean-per-GT-part IoU of Hair/FaceDomain/Upper/Lower; equal25percent each. Null on any prediction/scoring incompleteness or missing positive target support.
secondary: per-target mean Dice and pooled TP/FP/FN/IoU/Dice
day/night views with own explicit denominators
known Neck coverage on3 reviewed items
STRICT_COMPLETE: Exact90 saved prediction IDs plus accepted non-Face metrics, complete21 eligible Face tasks and3 delivery tasks per system; exclusions are pre-score GT-only dispositions, never model failures.
missing_prediction: Empty candidate -> FN on valid positive GT; no GT silhouette/bbox to repair predictions
invalid_prediction: 255/unknown native IDs are contract failures even on an uncertainty region; recognized OTHER is valid output
